Let me do a final review of the key implementation and re-run the verify command.

Task complete. Summary of what I did:

## Changes (all inside `scope`)

**`src/core/web-events.ts`** (new, 220 lines) — the server-owned invalidation core:
- `createInvalidationHub` owns exactly one chokidar watcher over the resolved `openspecRoot` (`ignoreInitial: true`). Paths are classified from normalized absolute paths into active/archive/rejected change folders and `.run` children, mapping to the leading numeric id; capability specs, root layout, and numericless folders make the batch global (empty id list).
- Notifications debounce for `serve.eventDebounceMs`; batches are deduplicated and numerically sorted. A monotonic token makes cancelled/post-close timer callbacks no-ops, and a closed hub ignores later events.
- `formatChangedEvent` emits exactly `event: changed\ndata: {"ids":[...]}\n\n`.
- `createEventStream` owns `/api/events` responses: HEAD returns matching headers with no stream/body; GET writes keep-open `text/event-stream` + `no-store` + `keep-alive`, flushes headers, tracks responses with idempotent `close`/`error` cleanup, and ends all clients on close.

**`src/core/web-server.ts`** (235 lines) — constructs the hub/stream once at startup (not per route), routes `GET`/`HEAD /api/events`, and extends the existing `close()` to clear the debounce timer → end SSE responses → close the watcher → close the listener. Watcher-init failure rejects before a listener exists; listen failure closes the watcher before rethrowing.

**`tests/serve-sse.test.ts`** (new) — injectable fake watcher + manual debounce clock prove one-watcher ownership, classification, sorted/unique/global batches, cancellation and post-close silence, exact framing/headers, HEAD parity, fan-out, idempotent disconnect cleanup, close ordering, and both startup rollbacks. One real chokidar case awaits `ready` and an explicit SSE connection, writes several files in a temporary change, then one capability spec.

## Verification
- Task verify: **52 pass, 0 fail**
- `pnpm tsc --noEmit`, `pnpm test` (1216 pass), `pnpm lint` all clean
- Both new source files under the 250-line budget

Result written to `openspec/changes/044-read-only-dashboard/.run/results/3.md`.
